title: Coldcard Postmortem Says Weak Seeds, Not Hacked Devices, Drove Bitcoin Thefts
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Coldcard Postmortem Says Weak Seeds, Not Hacked Devices, Drove Bitcoin Thefts

Coinkite published its full Coldcard postmortem, saying a five-year firmware flaw weakened wallet seeds and that about 242 customer accounts have reported losses.

This post Coldcard Postmortem Says Weak Seeds, Not Hacked Devices, Drove Bitcoin Thefts first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: UniCredit Opens Bitcoin to Italian Savers, Capping Gains at 65%
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

UniCredit Opens Bitcoin to Italian Savers, Capping Gains at 65%

UniCredit began selling a six-year, capital-protected certificate linked to BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin ETP to retail clients in Italy, with gains capped at 65%.

This post UniCredit Opens Bitcoin to Italian Savers, Capping Gains at 65% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: South Korea Unveils Crypto Bill Capping Exchange Ownership at 20%
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

South Korea Unveils Crypto Bill Capping Exchange Ownership at 20%

South Korea’s financial regulator unveiled a bill that would cap major shareholders of crypto exchanges at 20%, allow domestic ICOs and let bank-led groups issue won stablecoins.

This post South Korea Unveils Crypto Bill Capping Exchange Ownership at 20% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: DOJ Moves to Forfeit $1.1 Billion in USDC Stolen in Binance Hack
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

DOJ Moves to Forfeit $1.1 Billion in USDC Stolen in Binance Hack

The Justice Department filed to forfeit more than $1.1 billion in USDC stolen from Binance by North Korean hackers, and Circle agreed to issue replacement tokens.

This post DOJ Moves to Forfeit $1.1 Billion in USDC Stolen in Binance Hack first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
